in_sanskrit.name: इच्छा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root of the word Ichha is the Sanskrit word 'icch' which means 'to desire' or 'to wish'. The suffix '-a' is added to make it a feminine noun. So, Ichha means the one who has a strong desire or the one who has a strong intent.

in_hindi.name: ईच्छा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ichha is pronounced as 'ईच्छा' (īcchā) in Hindi. It retains the same meaning as in Sanskrit, i.e., desire, wish, or intent.

in_tamil.name: இச்சை
